t: You are at Golders Green tube station, on the Edgware branch of the Northern line between Brent Cross and Hampstead. It stands at the crossroads of Finchley Road and Golders Green Road, next to the bus station. Beside it is the former Golders Green Hippodrome, which was home to the BBC Concert Orchestra for many years. The athlete Cecil Griffiths died here in 1945. He was a Welsh runner who won a gold medal at the 1920 Olympics, and who carried on racing successfully in domestic competitions after being barred from the 1924 Games.
